tool.name: NVIDIA Nsight Systems
tool.installation_scope: project-local .tools/nsight-systems-2026.5.1; extracted only, no system installer executed

platform: WSL Ubuntu 24.04.4, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU, driver 582.05

workload.note: 9 acceleration samples include warm-up and measured launches. The two kernels use the same input and profiler configuration.

conclusion: For this profiled short workload, the tiled acceleration kernel is faster than naive. CUDA API totals include one-time initialization and profiler overhead, so they are not used as an application speed comparison.
limitations: This is a short profiler workload, not the 4096x1000 or 65536x1000 performance benchmark.
Nsight Compute 2025.1.1 remains unavailable on this GPU/WSL setup; no occupancy or warp-stall claims are made.
